episodes.title: Le Bambole (The Dolls)
episodes.summary: The disappearance of her old friend, Lila Cerrullo, causes 60-year-old author Elena Greco to reflect on the early days of their friendship in 1950s Naples, when Elena and Lila are two very different girls at the top of their class. When the girls discover the underground lair of Don Achille, a criminal figure who controls the neighborhood, they decide to confront him, facing their fears together and laying the cornerstone of a lasting friendship and rivalry.

episodes.title: I Soldi (The Money)
episodes.summary: As fourth grade draws to an end, Elena and Lila fight with their families for the chance to continue their education. Later, a trip out of town becomes a day Elena will never forget, and a death changes things in the neighborhood forever.

episodes.title: Le Metamorfosi (The Metamorphoses)
episodes.summary: Now a teenager, Elena grapples with the onset of puberty, her studies, and her friendship with Lila, who now works in her family's shoe-repair store. After a library awards ceremony reveals what Lila has been keeping secret, Elena learns what her friend's grand plans might be. As the girls' encounters with the opposite sex become more and more frequent, Lila takes a stand against the dangerous Solara brothers.

episodes.title: Le Smarginatura (Dissolving Margins)
episodes.summary: Entering high school, Elena vows to stay ahead of Lila, academically and romantically. Lila eschews a parade of suitors vying for her affection, choosing instead to focus on her ambitions in the shoe shop. Promising a better future for the neighborhood, Stefano Carracci invites Elena, Lila and their families over for New Year's Eve. Things escalate quickly during a fireworks faceoff with the Solaras, leading Lila to see a new side of her brother Rino.

episodes.title: Le Scarpe (The Shoes)
episodes.summary: Lila rejects two potential suitors at a cost; Elena prepares to spend the summer away from Lila and her family.

episodes.title: L'isola (The Island)
episodes.summary: On the island of Ischia, a visit by the Sarratore family leaves an indelible mark on Elena as she reaches her 15th birthday.

episodes.title: I Fidanzati (The Fiancés)
episodes.summary: Elena returns to Naples to find Lila has made a romantic connection with Stefano, despite the looming presence of Marcello. As Lila embraces a more glamorous life at Stefano's side, Elena warns her about what people are saying around the neighborhood. Later, in hopes of keeping up with her friend, Elena encourages one suitor and rebuffs the advances of another.

episodes.title: La Promessa (The Promise)
episodes.summary: With sales of Cerullo shoes lagging, Stefano cuts a business deal with the Solaras against Lila's wishes. After Elena gets kicked out of a class for voicing her opinion, Nino encourages her to write an article for his magazine about her experience. Later, Elena and Lila get unwelcome surprises.

episodes.title: Il nuovo cognome (The New Name)
episodes.summary: With Lila on her honeymoon on the Amalfi Coast, Elena struggles to handle school and her relationship with Antonio. When Lila returns with visible bruises on her body, the two girls revert to their natural closeness and Lila's will to take revenge against her husband grows. Elena continues to be bewitched by Nino Sarratore's charisma but chooses not to mention him to Lila.

episodes.title: Il corpo (The Body)
episodes.summary: Elena's relationship is threatened when Antonio discovers she has asked the Solaras' help to keep him from doing military service, while Lila remains rebellious in her marriage to the often-violent Stefano. After a photo of her is exhibited at a wedding dress shop in the center of town and becomes the subject of much gossip, Lila makes a bet with Elena about how the whole affair will end.

episodes.title: Scancellare (Erasure)
episodes.summary: Upset that her picture is featured prominently in the new shoe shop Stefano is opening with the Solaras, Lila comes up with a creative solution to deal with the matter and enlists Elena's help. Though Lila begins working at the Caraccis' new grocery store, she continues to resent her husband's business activities and the source of their income. Model student Elena invites Lila to a party at her teacher Ms. Galiani's house; there, the two girls become acutely aware of the fact that they belong to ever more distant worlds.

episodes.title: Il bacio (The Kiss)
episodes.summary: At Rino and Pinuccia's wedding, Elena accepts Lila's invitation to go on holiday, provided the destination is Ischia, where she knows she'll find Nino. On the island, Elena, Lila and Pinuccia begin to spend more and more time with Nino and his friend Bruno and Lila starts to take a strong interest in Elena's summer reads. As Lila and Pinuccia exhibit signs of nervousness when their respective husbands come to visit for the weekend, Elena is thrown when Lila comes to her bedroom to make a confession.

episodes.title: Il tradimento (The Betrayal)
episodes.summary: As Pinuccia returns to Naples, a new secret excites Lila and numbs Elena. Subdued by Lila's charisma and indifferent to Bruno's flattery, Elena finds herself the keeper of a far darker clandestine series of events involving Donato Sarratore. After the girls encounter Michele and Gigliola, Lila seizes the opportunity to throw the whole truth in Stefano's face.

episodes.title: La rabbia (The Anger)
episodes.summary: Following her summer on Ischia, Elena throws herself into her studies and looks towards a future outside of the neighborhood. After a brilliant finals performance, Elena happens upon Lila, who is working at the shoe store and has grand plans for a fresh start. Lila decides to leave Stefano and moves into a modest apartment, but the failings of her plan soon emerge.

episodes.title: I fantasmi (Ghosts)
episodes.summary: Three years into her time in Pisa, Elena has developed into an elegant and cultured young woman--but still feels like an outsider. After a consequential breakup, Elena falls ill and is visited by her mother, who has come to nurse her back to health. During the night, Elena takes to reading Lila's diaries, which were entrusted to her for safekeeping; in these tomes, Elena discovers Lila's dedication to her new role in the face of Stefano's increasingly violent behavior.

episodes.title: La fata blu (The Blue Fairy)
episodes.summary: Elena pens her first novel, which she entrusts to her new fiancé, before returning to Naples, where she finds Lila in her new life as a factory worker.

episodes.title: Sconcezze (Indecencies)
episodes.summary: At the Milanese presentation of her book, Elena unexpectedly meets Nino, who defends her from a particularly aggressive journalist; Elena's future mother-in-law, Adele, is very impressed by Nino and invites him to have dinner with them.

episodes.title: La febbre (The Fever)
episodes.summary: Pietro is in Naples to meet his future in-laws; Elena is very nervous, but her betrothed and the Greco family get along well; mother complains and tries to get Elena to change her mind about the civil ceremony; Lila sends for Elena.

episodes.title: La cura (The Treatment)
episodes.summary: Elena writes an article exposing the conditions at the Soccavo plant; Lila is determined to move back to the neighborhood.

episodes.title: Guerra fredda (Cold War)
episodes.summary: On their wedding day, Adele surprises Elena and Pietro; Elena struggles to write after the birth of her daughter.

episodes.title: Terrore (Terror)
episodes.summary: Following news of a murder in the neighborhood, Pasquale and Nadia suddenly descend on Elena's house.

episodes.title: Diventare (Becoming)
episodes.summary: After receiving shocking news from Lila about Elisa, Elena cuts the family holiday short to return to Naples.

episodes.title: Ancora tu (Try Again)
episodes.summary: With her marriage on the edge, Elena is further destabilized when Pietro brings Nino home for an unexpected visit.

episodes.title: Chi fugge, chi resta (Those Who Leave, Those Who Stay)
episodes.summary: When Nino praises her latest work, Elena's doubts about Pietro grow.

episodes.title: The Separation
episodes.summary: After leaving Pietro, Elena enjoys the success of her novel and frequent escapades with Nino – but grows concerned about the time spent away from Dede and Elsa. Rebuffed by both Immacolata and Adele, Elena considers moving back to Naples. Though Elena has been avoiding her old friend, Lila corners her with a shocking revelation about Nino.

episodes.title: The Dispersion
episodes.summary: Unable to forgive Nino's betrayal, Elena takes Dede and Elsa to stay in Milan with Mariarosa and Franco. Following a tragic event, Elena gives in and moves into Nino's place in Via Petrarca.

episodes.title: Compromises
episodes.summary: On a visit to the neighborhood for the first time in years, Elena attempts to make peace with Immacolata and learns that her mother has been unwell. Later, when Elena and Nino return from a trip to New York, she and Lila grow closer after revealing that they're both pregnant.

episodes.title: The Earthquake
episodes.summary: Elena and Lila spend the day together in the neighborhood, where Elena sees how well-respected Lila has become...as well as the peril brought on by Marcello's drug running operation. Later, Lila and Elena desperately try to reunite with their families after a sudden earthquake forces residents to flee the city.

episodes.title: The Fracture
episodes.summary: After Elena's daughter Imma is born, Lila brings Elena's mother to see the baby, but the visit is unexpectedly cut short when Immacolata collapses. When Nino and Lila take Immacolata to the hospital, Elena finds herself plagued with jealousy. Later, Marcello causes a scene when he insists Immacolata be moved to a clinic.

episodes.title: The Cheat
episodes.summary: As Lila goes into labor, Alfonso confides in Elena while accompanying her to the clinic to visit Immacolata. After a tragic loss – and stunned by Nino's actions yet again – Elena decides to focus on herself and takes refuge with her daughters at Lila's, who finally reveals the truth about Nino.

episodes.title: The Return
episodes.summary: Still reeling from her breakup, Elena reconnects with Antonio, who shares the full extent of Nino's betrayals. Later, Elena discovers that her newest book is a success, and tensions run high at Elisa and Marcello's wedding, as Elena learns the Solaras are ready to wage war against her for smearing their family name.

episodes.title: The Investigation
episodes.summary: After Elena discovers that Carmen has been pressured into suing her for slander, she and Lila decide to work together on an exposé of the Solaras' affairs. Later, Elena learns that their article may not be enough to put the brothers behind bars.

episodes.title: The Disappearance
episodes.summary: During Nino's long overdue visit to see Imma, a sudden and mysterious disappearance rocks the neighborhood. Though the Solaras help organize a search, Enzo remains suspicious of their involvement, while Lila becomes consumed by her own conspiracies. Later, Lila is driven further to the brink by her son's drug habit and another sudden loss.

episodes.title: Restitution
episodes.summary: After learning that Pasquale and Nadia have been arrested, Lila informs Elena that Gennaro has run away. Though Lila is unphased, Elena tries to manage the crisis when she learns Elsa has gone with him as well. Many years later, Lila manages to surprise her friend yet again.
